title: Part Two: How the State Is Built

sections.brief: US Constitution (Article V, 27 amendments, Tenth Amendment) vs Israel's Basic Laws (Harari Resolution 1950; 14 as of Oct 2026 incl. Torah Study 13 July 2026, 63-52; entrenchment of Freedom of Occupation and Knesset s.4, correcting the 'simple majority for all' claim; Bank Mizrahi 1995); presidential separation vs parliamentary coalition; federal vs unitary (258 local authorities, 12.8% of public spending, Interior Ministry approval, arnona). Figures: time; compare

Judicial review in both; Israel's overhaul 2023-2026 (reasonableness amendment 24 July 2023, struck down 8-7 on 1 Jan 2024, 13 or 12 of 15 on reviewing Basic Laws; Judicial Selection Law 27 Mar 2025 effective next Knesset; AG dismissal annulled 7-0 on 14 Dec 2025); US Supreme Court's IEEPA tariff ruling 20 Feb 2026 (6-3); trust in courts over time (Gallup 1972-2026; IDI 2025); Olmert, Katsav, Netanyahu's trial and pardon request, status as of Oct 2026. Figures: time; stats

Israel's state of emergency since May 1948 (ordinance s.9; Basic Law: The Government s.38; annual renewal; 1991 ICCPR derogation; dependent laws per Adalah 2003; Defence (Emergency) Regulations 1945 and military government to 1966; ACRI petition 1999-2012) vs US National Emergencies Act 1976 (75 declared and 41 in force May 2022; 51 in force 19 Oct 2026; IEEPA tariffs and the 2026 ruling). Figures: compare; time

Civil service: US 2025 departures (~317,000), -12% Sept 2024-Jan 2026, Schedule Policy/Career (effective 8 Mar 2026, up to 50,000); Israel's legal-adviser conflict and political appointments (IDI); Transparency International CPI 2012-2025 for both (US 73->64, Israel 60->62), with method caveats. Figures: compare; stats
